feastLines.line: 🔥 The fire settles. the man in his 40s has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A red moon rising between the trees, breathing — I put it down today." "The gills begin to breathe — a sweet, wrong smell rolls out from under the cap. The air shimmers." "The cap tilts. The stem creaks like a ship's mast. Get out from under it." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Hussein asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Aki says quietly "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. the man in his 30s, the bike messenger has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer — I put it down today." "It rears up, belly swelling drum-taut, and beats it with both paws — BOOM. The air itself flinches." "It waddles left, then is suddenly right — a feint, testing whether your eyes or your ears are in charge." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the man in his 40s asks "Tell me you didn't go alone." Hussein says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." 🔥 The fire settles. Aki has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Cliffhanger — I put it down today." "It goes perfectly still. Only the eyes move. Then the water explodes — and the world starts spinning." "It has your leg. The roll starts. Do NOT let it reach the water." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Hussein breathes "Tell me you didn't go alone." Pavel asks "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Klaus has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hushpuppy — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Pavel asks "And you're still standing." Ruby breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Ruby has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Dustboar — I put it down today." "It drops its head and paws the earth — once, twice — and the dust comes up in a wall. Tusks down. It is not going around you." "It swings its whole head sideways, tusks sweeping like scythes. The warts on its face are armor; the tusks are the argument." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Leo asks "We've been walking past those." Aki mutters "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we call

🔥 The fire settles. Esteban has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Night Court — I put it down today." "No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and there is no sound at all. Owls don't make sound when they hunt." "It missed — and it is already turning. The second dive re-aims at where you moved." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ruby breathes "And you're still standing." Owen says "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Owen has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hummice — I put it down today." "A low hum rises from the grass. It harmonizes with itself. Your teeth ache." "Teeth in the grass, everywhere at once — a tide of small bites." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Pavel mutters "The fire feels smaller now." Leo asks "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

EUREKA — the biggest burst so far." "It flickers — a smaller, meaner idea. Less certain, faster." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ruby mutters "So it bleeds." Brianna breathes "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Klaus has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Paparazzo — I put it down today." "The flash charges — whine rising. When it fires, you freeze in place." "Every shot refines its model — hit or miss. At 4, the money shot is unavoidable." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Brianna mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Leo asks "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Ruby has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Rut King — I put it down today." "He lowers the crown. Paws the earth once, twice. The whole forest holds its breath." "His chest swells. The inhale goes on too long — cover your ears or get behind something." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Maya says "Tell me you didn't go alone." Nair breathes "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Klaus has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Esteban says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Pavel asks "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keepsake. Think about them. The System will do the math. (It is not math. It is love. The System will never know.) Channel keepsakes from your pack.
